articles.title: Macy's Big Parade Turns 100 — a Little Late, but Bigger Than Ever
articles.summary: The 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade moved to Saturday, November 28, because of wind and flooding, with a record 100 balloons, star singers and free ways to watch.

articles.title: What Do You Want to Be When You Grow Up?
articles.summary: Time for Kids asked its Kid Reporters about their dream jobs — from engineer to reporter to Supreme Court justice — and how their goals have changed.

articles.title: Great Britain Reach the Davis Cup Semi-Finals!
articles.summary: Henry Patten and Neal Skupski won the deciding doubles match against Germany, sending Great Britain to the Davis Cup semi-finals for the first time since 2019.
